2121610200247349565.en_summary: $CRDO The connectivity inside AI clusters: the chips that move data between servers at the speeds AI training demands. As racks get denser, the interconnect layer takes a larger share of what a system costs, and $CRDO sits in that layer. It is a picks-and-shovels name on the networking side, with the same concentration risk as the rest of the fabric trade.
2121610200247349565.zh_summary: $CRDO AI集群內部的連接性：以AI訓練要求的速度在服務器之間移動數據的芯片。隨著機架更密集，互連層佔據系統成本的更大份額，$CRDO位於該層。它是網絡側的鍛和鍬名稱，與其他織物交易有相同的集中風險。
